prompt: Перевір залежності репозиторію dev-digest — наскільки вони важкі, чи є вразливі пакети, і що варто зробити в першу чергу?
assertions: Report covers multiple/all packages (server, client, reviewer-core, e2e, mcp-server, evals), not just one
Report includes a visual dependency diagram (Mermaid or equivalent)
Report includes per-package or per-dependency size data derived from actually installed node_modules (not guessed/generic numbers)
Report includes real vulnerability data pulled from npm/pnpm audit (specific package names + severities), not generic security advice
Report ends with a ranked/prioritized action list (not just raw tables)
Report correctly distinguishes pnpm-managed vs npm-managed packages rather than assuming one package manager for the whole repo
If a package has no installed node_modules (e.g. e2e), the report flags this as a data gap rather than silently reporting zero or omitting it without comment
